newsitem.title: UK: British unemployment falls to 6.9 percent.
newsitem.headline: British unemployment falls to 6.9 percent.

text.p: British unemployment fell to 6.9 percent in November from 7.2 percent in October, the Office for National Statistics said on Wednesday.
The number of people out of work fell by 95,800, the biggest fall since 1971, to 1.93 million.
It was the first time the jobless total has been below the psychologically important two million since February 1991.
However, the statistics office said 20,000 of the fall was due to the introduction of a new job scheme for the unemployed.
The fall was much greater than analysts had expected and government bond prices fell sharply.
Other official figures showed retail sales rose 0.7 percent in November after a 0.5 percent rise in October.
